input: Native intermittent WASD, E, food shortcuts, spaced Space attacks and camera drags. Game remained active while stationary between actions; pause intervals excluded.

route.note: Continued the normal completed m4 journey after a quota interruption.
Swam from coast, gathered wood and spoke to 林栖; completed-lighthouse dialogue was already correct.
Actual crab encounter: 40/40 approaching at 6 metres, five Space presses spaced about one second, enemy panel hidden after defeat; reward berry eaten to restore HP100.
Crossed northern sea, earlier boar encounter killed two enemies (5→7) and reduced HP100→28; three reward berries restored HP82. Spoke to 远舟; incorrect post-completion material request observed.
Return-coast boar defeat 7→8; gathered resources and two berries, food use restored HP100. 阿岚 incorrectly repeated the dark-lighthouse starter dialogue.

Swam to fourth island. Crab40/40 at6m, multiple creatures visible. Gathered stone then eight Space presses at900ms intervals; five enemies defeated, food0→5 and enemy panel hidden. Three reward berries restored HP100/food2. Individual enemy damage sequences were not captured.
Returned through sea, completed ten active minutes, saved and reloaded. Quest6/building1/position/HP/kills/food preserved.

observedQualityGaps: Camera avoidance repeatedly flipped North/East/West and changed subsequent camera-relative travel; a post-fix attempt to return to 远舟 stopped at a coastal tree instead of reaching him.
Nearby rock and NPC occasionally filled the foreground or hid the player. Gathering removed the resource obstruction, but camera/NPC occlusion quality remains open.
Simple faces, geometric NPC/creature/landmark forms, sparse repeated ground vegetation and material/lighting limits remain visible.
Success toast and final attack-miss feedback can coexist.
bounds: Ten active minutes, 36001 rAF intervals and eleven JS-heap snapshots; about another ten minutes of pause time excluded.
Movement was intermittent native keypresses, not ten minutes of continuously held movement. Several real multi-enemy fights and all four island regions were visited within the sample.
All minute checkpoints happened between fights and show enemy:null; actual encounter evidence comes from separate visible HUD observations.
Frame scheduling is not GPU timing; bounded heap snapshots do not prove absence of leaks.
No physical mobile test, audio listening, saved image/video or downloaded-save-file proof was added.
Runtime fingerprint was checked unchanged before sampler completion. The keeper/explorer dialogue fix was applied afterward; do not label this sample as the exact final package source.
